## Summary

Adds a source-grounded baseline of the existing ecosystem CI workflow surface before any new pipeline is introduced.

## Findings recorded

- Inventories the 19 workflow files present on the inspected `main` revision.
- Maps existing component, catalog, security, determinism, E2E and release-readiness coverage.
- Records the known weak determinism invocation for the Rust scan using `--test-cmd "true"`.
- Separates workflow definitions from exact-SHA run evidence and from global release authorization.
- Lists prioritized P0/P1/P2 reconciliation tasks and preserves SSOT ownership boundaries.
